short1.title: Curiosity Ran Over a Rock on Mars. Pure Sulfur Was Inside.
short1.description:
NASA's Curiosity rover cracked a rock in Gediz Vallis, Mars, in 2024. Inside: yellow crystals of pure sulfur, the first ever found on Mars. How they formed is still debated.

Images: NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS (Mastcam, MAHLI).
#Shorts #Mars #space #NASA

short2.title: Mars From Orbit: Nothing. On the Ground: Pure Sulfur
short2.description:
From orbit, this patch of Mars looked unremarkable: the HiRISE camera can see Curiosity, but not the stones. On the ground, the rover found a field of them, made of pure sulfur.

Images: NASA/JPL-Caltech/University of Arizona (HiRISE); NASA/JPL-Caltech/MSSS (Mastcam, MAHLI).
#Shorts #Mars #space #NASA
